summary: Iteration 203 - Meeting-to-Channel Sync and Admin Approvals testing complete. Backend: 15/15 tests passed (100%). Frontend: 7/7 tests passed (100%). All meeting sync endpoints working, AdminApprovalPanel modal functional, MeetingChannelBanner displaying correctly on meeting-followup channels.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminApprovalPanel.jsx: Clean modal implementation with proper data-testids. Shows pending approvals grouped by channel with approve/deny buttons. Empty state displays correctly.
MeetingChannelBanner.jsx: Banner correctly displays meeting source info (title, member count, internal-only status). Collapsible with external pending members section for admin approval.
LumiMessenger.jsx: Admin Approvals bento tile properly integrated at line ~1135 with data-testid='bento-admin-approvals'. MeetingChannelBanner rendered for meeting-followup channels at line ~878.
karau_meet.py: Line 518 end_meeting correctly calls convert_meeting_to_channel after ending a meeting. Integration between KARAU and ENZI is complete.
seed_data_creation: Test data was seeded - 3 meeting-followup channels exist: mtg-e0c06c18 (Team Standup), mtg-test-ext1 (Product Review Q1), mtg-aafb6e93 (Test Meeting for Channel Sync). External members in mtg-test-ext1 were approved during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Meeting-to-Channel Sync feature is complete and tested. When a KARAU meeting ends, it auto-creates an ENZI channel. Internal members (same domain) are added automatically, external members require admin approval. Admin Approval Panel accessible from ENZI dashboard bento tile 'Admin Approvals'. MeetingChannelBanner appears on meeting-followup channels showing meeting context. All APIs work: GET/PUT /settings, GET /pending-approvals, POST /approve-external, POST /deny-external, GET /channels, POST /convert. No pending approvals currently exist (all were approved during testing).
